summary: performance lens over ASKFLOOR-1-T6 (13 product path(s), 401a889..334d6fd, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 0 blocking, 2 non-blocking. The runtime introduces process-wide outage state with no production bound or cleanup for inactive conversations. In addition, the required invariance proof substitutes generic IPC/CRM requests for several named execution paths, leaving meaningful regressions undetected.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Outage latch retains inactive conversation keys indefinitely (apps/core/src/application/permissions/permission-judge-outage-latch.ts:27): Every first unavailable result permanently inserts a string into the process-wide `openKeys` set, and the only production removal occurs when the same key later receives an `Answered` result.

Invariance suite does not exercise several lanes it claims to cover (apps/core/test/unit/runtime/askfloor-invariance.test.ts:82): The matrix replaces any fixture without an explicit tool with `mcp__crm__lookup`, so the row labeled scheduler/admin/destructive/family-rail passes `rm -rf build` only as an unused extra property and actually evaluates a CRM lookup.
